reddit.headline: How the A Varied Garden daily task counts three flower types
reddit.body:
One of Basil's Garden Tasks asks you to plant three different flower varieties. The important part is variety: this demonstration uses one rose, one lavender, and one sunflower, so the counter moves from 1/3 to 3/3. This is separate from the birdhouse habitat recipe, which checks nearby flowers around an object.

Does showing the progress counter alongside each planting make the rule clear?
